title: Event Capacity Replan
core_conflict: An event plan says full capacity is approved, while venue updates and registration evidence require capped admission, waitlist handling, and revised communications.
required_constraints: include contradictory event plan, venue, and registration evidence
include workspace files, operations emails, task-board replan items, and venue/calendar constraints
include dynamic updates that change capacity, waitlist, or communication requirements after early rounds
emphasize calendar/task coordination, dynamic capacity updates, and workflow re-planning
